chunks: From him, from Ahmad, from his father, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Zareeh ibn Yazeed al-Muharabi, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said:
Excellent is the world as an aid towards the Hereafter.

key_terms.الآخرة: the Hereafter — the primary destination and ultimate purpose of human existence
key_terms.الدنيا: the world / worldly life — here understood as a divinely given resource for spiritual striving
key_terms.نعم العون: excellent is the aid — a classical Arabic formula of commendation (نعم + subject + predicate)

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq say about the relationship between worldly life and the Hereafter?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) affirms that worldly life, when properly oriented, is the finest means of assistance for attaining success in the Hereafter. This teaching reflects the Shia theological position that asceticism does not mean rejecting the world entirely, but rather using it as a vehicle for spiritual advancement and good deeds. The original audience would have understood this as countering extreme world-renunciation while encouraging active, purposeful engagement with worldly affairs for the sake of the next life.
